text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Well done.
That was not bad entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Don't get conceited. It is still not enough."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "If you wish to give me pleasure, you must hone your skills even further."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Continue to exert yourself for my sake.
...Understood?
